card.name: Words in monitoring and tolerance conditions
card.fires_on: Words inside conditional or observational phrases about watching for reactions, such as "If no signs", "if the first infusion is tolerated", and "patients should be observed". It also fires on a few word endings in drug and body terms.

modes.label: If-clauses about reactions
modes.description: Words in "if no reactions / if tolerated" clauses that tell the reader to proceed when nothing bad appears.
modes.example: If<< no>> signs or symptoms of anaphylactic

modes.label: Observe patients carefully
modes.description: Words in "patients should be observed carefully for signs" instructions.
modes.example: patients should<< be>> observed carefully for signs and symptoms of pancre

modes.label: Partway through a term
modes.description: The ending of a body or drug term, such as gallbladder or atomoxetine.
modes.example: ezetimibe increased cholesterol in the gallbl<<adder>> bile

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern.
